title: Yellow Spicy Egyptian Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and spicy Egyptian dish featuring lamb, cayenne pepper, and coconut cream, perfect for a midnight craving. This sugar-free-friendly recipe is cooked to perfection in a terracotta dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large terracotta dish, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the cayenne pepper, salt, black pepper, turmeric, and paprika, and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cover the dish with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce is thick and jammy.
